items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: "they might hold me up, Daniel, for a while."

ctx.x: He got something to kick out of me. You said you went back to the council and said you got a...

Yeah, I went to the council and he gave me a card, a certificate, you know, a card that they wouldn't hold me up on the border. And he said, now listen, he says, they blowed up the track the other day in Victoria on the way to Monterey and said, you got a chance to go, said they're going to have some soldiers on the train. And I said, we can't guarantee you get there and say, if you want to take a chance, I told him, yeah, I want to take a chance because the band over there, you know, I scared it over there,…
So I let out for the border.
